## Initial Release

`kubectl-doc` renders Kubernetes OpenAPI v3 schemas as YAML-shaped documentation for terminal, web, and static output formats.

### Features

- **YAML documentation** (`-o yaml`): Manifest-shaped, syntactically valid YAML with embedded description comments, required field markers, and type annotations — rendered in the terminal with syntax colouring.
- **Interactive TUI** (`-o tui`, `-i`): Full-screen terminal UI with a resource overview, schema viewer, version selection, and real-time incremental filtering.
- **Interactive web browser** (`-o browser`, `-w`): Localhost web server with resource navigation, schema viewer, and filtering UI accessible from any browser.
- **HTML output** (`-o html`): Self-contained single-file HTML page with interactive filtering, folded sections, and search UI.
- **Markdown output** (`-o markdown`, `-o markdown-github`): GitHub-flavoured Markdown pages with fenced YAML examples; `--all-versions` renders every served CRD version.
- **Kro output** (`-o kro`): Kro SimpleSchema-style YAML schema view.
- **Cluster discovery**: Resource lookup by plural name, singular name, kind, short name, or qualified form (e.g. `deployments.apps`).
- **CRD file support** (`-f`): Read a local CRD YAML manifest directly; select a specific version with `--version`.
- **Filtering**: Incremental real-time filtering of schema fields in both TUI and browser modes.

### Installation

Available via [Krew](https://krew.sigs.k8s.io/):

```shell
kubectl krew install doc
```

And via [Homebrew](https://brew.sh/):

```shell
brew install sttts/tap/kubectl-doc
```
